mapper.insert: INSERT INTO action_rebate_config (action_type, rebate_type, rebate_name, rebate_desc, rebate_value, config_id, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{actionType}, #{rebateType}, #{rebateName}, #{rebateDesc}, #{rebateValue}, #{configId}, #{state}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rebate_name = VALUES(rebate_name), rebate_desc = VALUES(rebate_desc), rebate_value = VALUES(rebate_value), config_id = VALUES(config_id), state = VALUES(state), update_time = NOW()
